from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_back_to_back_example():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # 540 = 9*60, 600 = 10*60, 660 = 11*60
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False


def test_issue_back_to_back_reversed():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # 540 = 9*60, 600 = 10*60, 660 = 11*60
    assert overlaps(Event(600, 660), Event(540, 600)) is False


def test_issue_one_minute_shared_overlaps():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    # 540 = 9*60, 600 = 10*60, 599 = 9*60+59, 660 = 11*60; shared minute is 599
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(599, 660)) is True


def test_issue_identical_events_overlap():
    """Events that do share at least one minute (including identical events) must still overlap."""
    # 540 = 9*60, 600 = 10*60
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(540, 600)) is True


def test_issue_contained_event_overlaps():
    """Events that do share at least one minute (including one event fully inside another) must still overlap."""
    # outer 540 = 9*60, 660 = 11*60; inner 560 = 9*60+20, 580 = 9*60+40
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 660), Event(560, 580)) is True


def test_issue_disjoint_events_no_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    # 540 = 9*60, 600 = 10*60, 660 = 11*60, 720 = 12*60; gap is 60 minutes
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(660, 720)) is False


def test_issue_back_to_back_leaves_no_free_gap():
    """Back-to-back events share no minute and must not leave a gap in free_slots."""
    # day 540 = 9*60 to 660 = 11*60 fully covered by [540,600)+[600,660)
    assert free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 540, 660) == []


def test_contract_free_slots_sorted_gaps():
    """free_slots returns the gaps as (start, end) tuples sorted by start."""
    # events unsorted: 660 = 11*60, 720 = 12*60, 540 = 9*60, 600 = 10*60; gap 600 = 10*60 to 660 = 11*60
    assert free_slots([Event(660, 720), Event(540, 600)], 540, 720) == [(600, 660)]


def test_contract_free_slots_min_minutes():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    # day 540 = 9*60 to 660 = 11*60, event to 600 = 10*60, gap 600->660 = 60 minutes < 61
    assert free_slots([Event(540, 600)], 540, 660, min_minutes=61) == []


def test_contract_free_slots_clipped():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    # day 540 = 9*60 to 720 = 12*60, event 500 = 8*60+20 to 560 = 9*60+20 clips to 540->560
    assert free_slots([Event(500, 560)], 540, 720) == [(560, 720)]  # 560 = 9*60+20, 720 = 12*60


def test_contract_parse_time():
    """parse_time turns HH:MM (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:00") == 540  # 9*60+0 = 540


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m)."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65 = 1*60+5
